annotations.text:
The app in the marketing site's register: #F4F5F3 paper, #14181D instrument panel, one green accent, IBM Plex Mono labels, Outfit numerals, hard 1px rules, no radii or shadows.

All six screens respond to taps — scenario band, timeframe, mode A-E, crop rows, alert filter and expand.

Desktop, 1440x900. The 260px sidebar is the real width from style.css.

Cut from the nav: How It Works, Built for NER, Impact — all three are already pages on the marketing site. The app's own landing page goes too, so /app/ opens on the Dashboard instead of a second pitch.

15 items down to 12, in three groups. Emoji replaced with stroke SVGs on a 24px grid. Active state is a paper fill plus a 3px ink rule, not the green pill.

One link out at the foot, back to the site for anything explanatory.
